description: Every course a department offers in a term, from the UMD Schedule of Classes: title, credits, grading methods, gen-ed codes, prerequisites and description. Sections are not included; call testudo_soc_get_sections or testudo_soc_get_course for those. No login needed.

term_id.description: Four-digit year followed by "01" (Spring), "05" (Summer), "08" (Fall) or "12" (Winter), e.g. "202608" for Fall 2026

name: testudo_soc_list_courses

courses.description: Courses in catalog order; empty when the department offers none that term

additional_information.description: The catalog's "Additional information" note; null if there is none

also_offered_as.description: The catalog's "Also offered as" note; null if there is none

corequisite.description: The catalog's "Corequisite" note; null if there is none

credit_only_granted_for.description: The catalog's "Credit only granted for" note; null if there is none

max.description: Maximum credits; equals min for a fixed-credit course

cross_listed_with.description: The catalog's "Cross-listed with" note; null if there is none

formerly.description: The catalog's "Formerly" note; null if there is none

gen_ed.description: General education requirements the course fulfills

name.description: Category and requirement, e.g. "Fundamental Studies - Academic Writing"

individual_instruction.description: true for individual-instruction courses (independent study, research) where the department must be contacted to register

notes.description: Term-specific notes for the course, e.g. special-topics blurbs or placement advice

permission_required.description: true when the department must grant permission to register

prerequisite.description: The catalog's "Prerequisite" note; null if there is none

recommended.description: The catalog's "Recommended" note; null if there is none

restriction.description: The catalog's "Restriction" note; null if there is none

syllabus_count.description: Number of past syllabi in the syllabus repository (see testudo_soc_list_syllabi)

name.description: Department name; null if the site lists nothing

website.description: The department's own website, if linked

seats_as_of.description: When the seat counts on this page were last refreshed, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in US Eastern time (roughly hourly); null if the page does not say

title: List courses in a department
